verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Option placement is skewed: of the five multiple-choice items, seeds 11, 78, 118 and 127 all key option C and only seed 57 keys A, so a pupil who always picks the third option scores 4 of 5.

verdicts.reasoning: Three items run the other direction: seed 42 hands over the numeral 35 and asks the pupil to build it from blocks, and seed 23 starts the dot parked at 40 and requires it moved to 42, so the pupil constructs the representation instead of reading one.
verdicts.action_taken: Left registered; the blind verdict is the evidence the entry needed, and nothing about the entry was changed.

verdicts.action_taken: Left registered; the blind verdict is the evidence the entry needed, and nothing about the entry was changed.
